armyRules.name: Pursuit of Perfection
armyRules.flavor: Perfection has to be seen to count, and a Legion that is not performing is a Legion that is failing.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic on a Battle Turn in which its Unit makes a Charge.
drawbacks: If a Unit with this Special Rule ends its Controlling Player's Battle Turn having made neither a Shooting Attack nor a Charge, it subtracts 1 from its Cool Checks until it makes one or the other.

armyRules.name: Exquisite Cruelty
armyRules.flavor: The Legion savours every kill and is dulled by every refusal.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule that wins a Combat has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule until the end of the following Battle Turn.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule that loses a Combat must immediately make a Cool Check with a -1 modifier.

armyRules.name: Peerless Duellist
armyRules.flavor: A son of the Third cannot resist a stage, and the stage is never large enough.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic while it is taking part in a Challenge.
drawbacks: If a Model with this Special Rule is slain in a Challenge, every friendly Emperor's Children Unit within 12" of it must make a Cool Check with a -1 modifier.

wargear.name: Laurels of Perfection
wargear.summary: A circlet of gold leaf awarded for a flawless victory, worn as though the next one were already won.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Laurels of Perfection adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic and 1 to its Initiative Characteristic.

wargear.name: Banner of Dissonance
wargear.summary: A standard strung with tuned bells and wire that howl in the wind of the charge.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Banner of Dissonance has the Fear (1) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Narcotic stimulants
wargear.summary: A cocktail of synaptic boosters that turns pain into pleasure and orders into noise.
wargear.text: A Unit equipped with Narcotic stimulants has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule, and every Model in it subtracts 1 from its Willpower Characteristic.

wargear.name: Mirrorbright plate
wargear.summary: Armour polished until it throws the light back in the eyes of anyone who strikes at it.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Mirrorbright plate has the Blinding Splendour Special Rule.

wargear.name: Siren-lute
wargear.summary: A hand-held instrument whose cadence is meant to be heard across a battlefield.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Siren-lute has the Siren Song Special Rule.

wargear.name: Trophy cloak
wargear.summary: A cloak stitched from the banners and sashes of fallen rivals.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Trophy cloak adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic and has the Collected Glories Special Rule.

wargear.name: Pain-glove
wargear.summary: A gauntlet of fine needles that rewards a duellist and wounds his partner in rhythm.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Pain-glove has the Exquisite Agony Special Rule.

wargear.name: Pavane drum
wargear.summary: A drum slung at the hip whose beat sets the pace of the advance.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Pavane drum has the Tempo of the Charge Special Rule.

wargear.name: Screech-field vents
wargear.summary: Tuned vents bolted to the hull that fill the air with a sound like tearing silk.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Screech-field vents has the Sonic Distortion Special Rule.

rites.name: The Flawless Host
rites.flavor: To the Third, a victory with a single flaw in it is a defeat in good clothes.
benefits: Palatine Blade squads, Phoenix Terminator Squads, Veteran Tactical Squads and Veteran Assault Squads may fill Troops slots.
Palatine Blade squads, Phoenix Terminator Squads and Veteran Assault Squads gain Line (1); Veteran Tactical Squads already have it.
Palatine Blade and Phoenix squads gain +1 Weapon Skill.
All those units gain Immaculate Ranks: they automatically pass Cool Checks while they have not lost a Model.
limitations: At least one Palatine Blade squad is required.
No Tactical, Despoiler, Assault, Breacher, Scout or Inductii Squads.

require.note: Bring at least one Palatine Blade squad.

rites.name: Symphony of Slaughter
rites.flavor: The battle is only the percussion. The screaming is the melody.
benefits: Kakophoni Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Fear (1).
Kakophoni gain Dirge of Pain: enemy units within 12" suffer -1 to Cool Checks.
limitations: At least two Kakophoni Squads are required.
Every Infantry unit in the army suffers -1 Intelligence from the din.

require.note: Bring at least two Kakophoni Squads.

modifiers.text: Symphony of Slaughter: Dirge of Pain, Fear (1).

rites.name: Descent of the Gilded Wings
rites.flavor: They fall like fireworks and are gone before anyone thinks to look away.
benefits: Palatine Blade Aquilae, Veteran Assault and Destroyer Assault Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Gilded Descent: they may Charge in the turn they arrive by Deep Strike.
Every Antigrav Infantry unit gains +1 Movement.
limitations: No Armour, Heavy Transport or War Engine units.
At least half of the units with Gilded Descent (rounded up) must start in Reserve.

modifiers.text: Descent of the Gilded Wings: Gilded Descent.
Descent of the Gilded Wings: +1 M.

rites.name: A Thousand Suns
rites.flavor: Each shot is composed. Each corpse is arranged. Nothing is left to chance but the applause.
benefits: Sun Killer Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and +1 Ballistic Skill.
They gain Composed Volley: their heavy weapons (Volkite culverin, plasma cannon, multi-melta, lascannon) gain Precision (6+) on their Shooting Attacks.
limitations: At least two Sun Killer Squads are required.
No Heavy Support, Tactical Support or Veteran Heavy Support Squads, and no Rapier or Tarantula Batteries.

require.note: Bring at least two Sun Killer Squads.

modifiers.text: A Thousand Suns: Composed Volley, Line (1).

rules.name: Immaculate Ranks
rules.summary: Not a plume out of place, and so not a man afraid to be seen.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule automatically passes any Cool Check it is required to make, provided it has not lost a Model at any point since the start of the battle.

rules.name: Dirge of Pain
rules.summary: The wail of the Kakophoni is meant to be remembered.
rules.text: While an enemy Unit is within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule, it subtracts 1 from the result of its Cool Checks.

rules.name: Gilded Descent
rules.summary: They fall like fireworks and are gone before anyone thinks to look away.
rules.text: A Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule that arrives from Reserves by Deep Strike may declare a Charge in the same Battle Turn it arrives. At the start of the battle, at least half of the Units in the army with this Special Rule (rounding up) must be placed in Reserves.

rules.name: Composed Volley
rules.summary: Each shot is composed. Each corpse is arranged.
rules.text: Each Shooting Attack made by a Model with this Special Rule using a Volkite culverin, plasma cannon, multi-melta or lascannon has the Precision (6+) Special Rule.

rules.name: Blinding Splendour
rules.summary: Gilded plate that turns every blow into a squint.
rules.text: While a Model with this Special Rule is taking part in a Challenge, enemy Models subtract 1 from the result of any Hit Test they make against it.

rules.name: Siren Song
rules.summary: A note pitched to root the listener where he stands.
rules.text: At the start of its Movement phase, an enemy Unit within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule must make a Cool Check. If it fails, it cannot Rush during that Battle Turn.

rules.name: Collected Glories
rules.summary: Another sash for the cloak, another reason to be looked at.
rules.text: When a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule destroys an enemy Character, that Model gains the Fear (1) Special Rule for the rest of the battle.

rules.name: Exquisite Agony
rules.summary: A slow, careful cruelty, delivered in time.
rules.text: Each time a Model with this Special Rule causes an unsaved Wound on an enemy Model in a Combat, the Unit that Model belongs to subtracts 1 from its Initiative Characteristic until the end of that Combat.

rules.name: Tempo of the Charge
rules.summary: The beat quickens and so do the boots.
rules.text: Once per battle, when a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule makes a Charge Roll, the Controlling Player may declare that the result is a 6 if it would otherwise be lower.

rules.name: Sonic Distortion
rules.summary: The air itself screams when the hull is near.
rules.text: Enemy Shooting Attacks that target a Vehicle with this Special Rule from more than 18" away subtract 1 from the result of their Hit Tests.
